basic_info.description: 3-bedroom Below Market Rate (BMR) housing opportunity available at 100% Area Median Income (AMI). Maximum income for 3 people = $134,850; 4 = $149,850; 5 = $161.850, etc. Must be 1st-time homebuyer & income eligible. Unit available thru the Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development (MOHCD) & subject to resale controls, monitoring & other restrictions. Unit will be listed on DAHLIA, the SF Housing  Portal (https://housing.sfgov.org) starting on the application date, 01/21/2025. Visit  https://housing.sfgov.org for application & program info. Application, loan pre-approval, and homebuyer education verification due on February 11, 2025 at 5:00 PM. Open House: January 25, 2025, 2:00 - 4:00  pm; January 26, 2025, 2:00 - 4:00 pm; and February 4, 2025, 5:00 - 7:00 pm  Fair Housing Opportunity
